subject: Intro + short demo to evaluate Redwood for real-time personalization
messages:
From: Evan Torres <evan@blastshop.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood for inference - quick demo?

Hi Jonas —

I signed up for the self-serve sandbox yesterday (evan@blastshop.ai). We're an e-commerce personalization team at Blastshop evaluating hosted inference for real-time candidate scoring. A quick 20- to 30-minute walkthrough of Redwood's runtime and cost model would help us figure out next steps.

High level:
- Use case: product personalization / ranking (ML model outputs used to reorder pages and emails)
- Current traffic: ~450K inference requests / month, average prompt ~35 tokens, peaks during promotions (~100 RPS)
- Expected growth: plan to hit ~1.5–2M requests/month in the next quarter if latency and unit cost look good
- Timeline: target pilot in ~6–8 weeks, production in Q1 2027

I've attached a small CSV with anonymized traffic slices so you can get a sense of our distribution (sample-traffic.csv). Also curious about EU data residency options — a couple of our markets require it.

Could you and someone from the product/sales engineering team do a short demo next week? 30 minutes should be fine.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Torres
Head of Personalization | Blastshop Inc.
evant@blastshop.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Torres <evan@blastshop.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for inference - quick demo?

Evan —

Thanks for the note and for uploading the sandbox account — appreciate the traffic sample. I'm cc'ing Marissa (SDR) to handle scheduling; I'll join the call and bring our Solutions Engineer.

A few quick qualification items so the demo is focused and we can surface the right benchmarks:
1) Is the 450K/month number current production traffic or a projection? Any seasonality (monthly vs promo spikes)?
2) For the 1.5–2M target, is that steady state or conservative growth over a quarter?
3) Typical request pattern: avg token length, expected response tokens, and whether you use streaming or synchronous responses?
4) Peak concurrency (RPS) and acceptable p95 latency target for the product (e.g., <200ms p95)?
5) Any compliance needs (EU residency, SOC 2, encryption requirements, customer data in prompts)?
6) Who should be on the demo from Blastshop (CTO, infra, ML eng)?

Proposed demo slots (30 min):
- Tue 27 Oct, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 28 Oct, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed 28 Oct, 15:00–15:30 PT
If none of these work, Marissa will coordinate alternate times.

I've attached a one-pager that summarizes what we'll demo (Redwood-onepager.pdf). If you can answer the quick questions above in a reply, we'll tailor the session (benchmarks, quantization options, and region recommendations).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Evan Torres <evan@blastshop.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 02:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for inference - quick demo?

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks — answers inline below. I'm copying Sophia Kim (CTO) on availability; she'll be the final approver.

1) 450K/month is current production traffic on our A/B ranking endpoint (rolling month). Promo windows double throughput for ~12–24 hours.
2) 1.5–2M is the expected steady-state in ~3 months if we fully roll the personalization model across channels.
3) Avg prompt length ~40 tokens, expected response length ~25 tokens. We'll use synchronous responses; streaming is not required for the first phase.
4) Peak: ~120 RPS during promos; p95 target ~150–200ms. We can accept slightly higher p95 for background channels but product-facing must stay snappy.
5) Compliance: EU residency required for EU customer data. SOC 2 evidence would be great.
6) Please include Sophia Kim (sophia@blastshop.ai) and our infra lead Mateo Alvarez (mateo@blastshop.ai) if possible.

Preferred slot: Wed 28 Oct, 09:00–09:30 PT — 30 minutes should be great.

Attaching an org chart to show who will join (blastshop-org-chart.pdf).

Evan

Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for inference - quick demo? — confirmed

Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent for:

Wed, 28 Oct 2026, 09:00–09:30 PT (30 min) — Redwood demo (Jonas + SE)
Google Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-demo-6672
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/Blastshop

I've attached the .ics for your calendar (calendar-invite.ics). If there's an internal Slack channel you prefer, please share and we'll post the join link.

Quick checklist ahead of the call:
- If you can share a small eval dataset (anonymized request/response pairs) that would help us run a short latency and cost projection ahead of time.
- Mental model we'll cover: latency profiles (p50/p95), cost per 1K tokens across a few quantization options, and routing by region for EU residency.

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
